_about: Where's My Car, as plain data. From Friday on, the beater by the gate turns out not to be yours. You have three memories of where you parked, each one slightly wrong; checking a memory means walking to its spot in the Parking Lot and talking to whoever is there. With all three checked you remember the key fob in your pocket: press it anywhere in the lot and your car chirps and flashes from a row that is not a row. Reward: cash from the cup holder and your hoodie, which stops the cold between 1 and 6 AM. Spots are world x, z.
opening: There it is. The beater. Right by the gate, exactly where I left it.
…Mine had a cassette stuck in the deck. This one has a CD stuck in the deck.
Lot of those about. Same year, same dent. I count nine.
Every festival is the same festival. Same field. They roll it up and move it. That's why you can't find your car. The car's fine. The FIELD moved.
I remember three things. A purple van. A flag. And a row number.
Three memories. Good luck. You find your car yet? …You won't. Love you, though.

memories.name: The purple van
memories.memory: You parked next to a purple van.
lines: You were next to a purple van? Friend, look around. Purple is the colour this year.
Also this one was green on Thursday. My cousin had the paint.
So it could be any van.
It could be no van. Vans leave. That's the thing about vans.

memories.name: The flag
memories.memory: There was a flag. A sun on it. Or a bird.
lines: It was a flag on Thursday. It had a sun on it.
It had a sun on it because it was in the sun. Now it's a towel. Things change, honey.
You look like somebody patting the wrong pocket.
memories.learned: Not the flag. It was a towel the whole time.

memories.name: The row sign
memories.memory: Row 4. Or Row 7. There was definitely a number.
lines: Which row do you want it to be?
Row 4, Row 7, Row Pi and Row 4 Again. Dad said find something to do.
memories.learned: Not the row. There are no rows. There is a kid.

fobThought: Three memories, three dead ends. You pat your pockets the way the Towel Lady said. Left pocket: lint. Right pocket: your car keys. They have been there since Thursday.
fobLines: Somewhere off to the north-east, past the last proper row, a car goes chirp-chirp.
Chirp-chirp. Further east than you would ever have parked.
Chirp-chirp. It sounds pleased with itself.
found: Raise you two zip ties. …Oh. Is this your table?
We thought it was the lot's car. It's been very welcoming.
It was by the gate. I parked by the gate.
And where's the gate now? Exactly. Your hoodie's on the back seat, we didn't touch it. There's a lot of change in the cup holder. We touched some of that.
